plan.notes: TRACK DISCLOSURE: WSU's catalog requires every Computer Science major to complete ONE of the two CS concentrations (Big Data Analytics or Software Development) plus the major core and ancillary courses — there is no official no-concentration 'BS Computer Science' sequence. This plan is the official 'Department of Computer Science: Software Development Concentration — Sample Timeline for Completion of Degree' (Plan of Study Grid). True degree name verified: 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science' (collegedunia lists 'Bachelor of Science [B.S] (Computer Science)'; idp.com 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science – Worcester State University'); catalog program page is titled 'Computer Science Major, Concentration in Software Development'. Catalog year is 2024-2025, the actual year of the source: the archived 2024-2025 catalog is the newest official term-by-term sequence; the current (live) catalog's concentration page no longer publishes the sample timeline (it shows only requirements), so the archived grid is used. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the archived catalog's Plan of Study Grid. CURRICULUM DRIFT CAVEAT: the live catalog's Major in Computer Science page now describes a 12-course core (50 credits, incl. CS-135 'Introduction to Programming' and CS-140 'Object Oriented Programming' plus one CS elective), differing from the 2024-2025 timeline's core (CS-101 'Basics of Computer Science', CS-140 'Introduction to Programming'). The timeline is transcribed as published; it was not updated to the newer core. This four-year plan assumes a Math Placement score of at least 6 (placement details in notes, not external_prereqs): footnote 1 — if the student's placement requires MA-190, take it in Semester One so MA-200 can be taken in Semester Two. CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the grid prints semester totals 16/14/15/15/16/16-17/13/15 with 'Total Credits 120-121'. The 3-4 credit Math/Science elective in Semester Six is modeled at 3 credits, so the file sums to exactly 120 (the published range 120-121 is preserved in the choice_note). Catalog minimum for graduation: 120 credits. Blank-slot labeling: the grid leaves several slots unlabeled; where the catalog PDF labels them (FYS, CON, GP, CA, LASC), those tags are used in the code/title; unlabeled upper-year blanks are 'LASC Elective' or 'Free Elective' choice slots — if LASC requirements are not yet satisfied the student chooses a LASC-designated course, otherwise general electives. Prereqs: the sample timeline does not publish per-course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty (not reconstructed). Other catalog notes: students must meet with their academic advisor each semester; first-year/transfer students with 45 or fewer credits at admission must complete two academic programs (major/major or major/minor, MajorPlus) to graduate; a laptop (Windows/macOS/Linux, 16GB suggested; no Chromebook) is required for CS courses. Source: https://catalog.worcester.edu/archives/2024-2025/undergraduate/school-education-health-natural-sciences/computer-science/major-computer-science-concentration-software-development/
